jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.



If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.


**THE WORK:**



The Customer Success Manager plays a key role in driving revenue, product adoption and retention across the Ripple Treasury customer base in EMEA. Acting as a trusted advisor to Heads of Treasury, Finance leaders and CFOs, the CSM will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts — deepening relationships, accelerating adoption of Ripple Treasury's cash, liquidity, forecasting, payments, netting, reconciliation capabilities, and supporting expansion and renewal opportunities across Ripple's product suite


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**


* Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise treasury accounts across EMEA, with responsibility for adoption, retention, satisfaction and growth outcomes.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's treasury organisation, technical landscape, internal decision\-making, aspirations and needs — mapping their workflows to measurable success outcomes on the Ripple Treasury platform.
* Build trusted, senior\-level relationships with Heads of Treasury, Finance leaders and CFOs, serving as an advisor and Ripple advocate.
* Run QBRs and executive\-level success reviews; conduct financial, business and value analysis tied to customer targets such as cost reduction, forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Own the commercial health of your portfolio: maintain an early\-warning view of churn risk (health scores, usage decline, escalations, sentiment), flag at\-risk accounts to AM/RM with a documented save plan, and build account strategies that identify and progress renewal, upsell and cross\-sell opportunities through to deal execution.
* Champion the innovation and product agenda across your book of business, turning each release into measurable customer adoption.
* Drive customer references and advocacy across the portfolio, building a pipeline of referenceable accounts and advocacy assets (case studies, testimonials, event speakers…) in partnership with Marketing.
* Lead and support customer events across the EMEA region, driving engagement and community\-building within your book of business.
* Resolve complex product and operational issues by partnering with Support, Engineering and Technical Services, and by leading deep root\-cause analysis where required.
* Represent the voice of the customer across Ripple; collect and communicate customer feedback to Product, Engineering and GTM to shape the roadmap.
* Maintain admin and operational excellence across your book of business, keeping account data and response SLAs at a consistently high standard.
* Contribute to scalable Customer Success processes, playbooks and enablement resources, and mentor newer team members through knowledge\-sharing and peer onboarding.
* Identify and champion internal process improvements.


**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**



* Fluency in English is required; German and/or French are a plus.
* 4\+ years of experience in customer\-facing roles within enterprise SaaS, FinTech or financial services, ideally in Customer Success or strategic account management.
* Deep domain expertise in corporate treasury: cash and liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, netting, payments and settlement, bank connectivity… — hands\-on practitioner experience in a corporate treasury function is a strong plus.
* Direct experience with Treasury Management Systems (e.g. Ripple Treasury, Kyriba, IT2, Quantum, or similar), as an implementer, power user or vendor\-side advisor.
* A track record of managing a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts with meaningful ARR ownership, and of driving measurable adoption, retention and expansion outcomes.
* Demonstrable understanding of multi\-stakeholder management in complex enterprise environments, including engagement with C\-level and senior treasury stakeholders.
* Experience running QBRs and executive business reviews, and conducting value and business analysis against customer financial targets.
* Excellence in building relationships across cross\-functional, global teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions, Sales, Marketing, Legal).
* Familiarity with Customer Success tooling (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight) and analytics/BI tools (e.g. Pendo, Qlik Sense) is a plus.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with experience coaching and enabling peers; a highly self\-motivated individual who operates proactively and is driven to create impact and succeed.


**WHO WE ARE:**



Do Your Best Work


* The opportunity to build in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with experienced industry leaders
* A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
* Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
* In\-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10\+ days a month they come in.
* Bi\-weekly all\-company meeting \- business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
* We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!


Take Control of Your Finances


* Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

jobs.title: Principal, AI/ML Infrastructure Planning
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of technical infrastructure program managers, software engineers, data specialists, supply chain specialists, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for planning and execution while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, delivers, and operates the global data\-center fleet that powers every AWS service. Our servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling assets in more than 245 countries and territories. We tackle some of the world’s most complex supply\-chain problems so our customers can innovate without limits.  

  

In this team you will drive end to end planning for a wide portfolio of AI/ML servers. You will engage with senior leaders and working teams across a wide variety of functional areas on the necessary inputs that enable landing of servers in data centers in time to meet customer demand. You will drive short, medium, and long term planning efforts and engage with software teams to deliver systems that optimize the planning process. To deliver the right outcomes, you will need to implement strong mechanisms to identify defects and create feedback loops to the appropriate teams. Ability to engage with the most senior levels in the AWS organization, both in written and verbal form is critical.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of program management, tech program management, or related experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
* 4\+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Management, Information Systems, or other related discipline
* Experience managing programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
* Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
* Experience performing complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and presenting the justification to management in a high\-level review
* Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
* Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
* Master's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

USA, VA, Herndon \- 176,900\.00 \- 239,400\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
**Location: City of Bossier City, Bossier Parish, LA**


**Agency: Bossier City\-Parish Metropolitan Planning Commission**


**Job Title: Associate/Assistant Planner**


**Job Location: Onsite**


**Position Overview**


The Bossier City – Parish Metropolitan Planning Commission is seeking a full\-time


professional to assist in bringing community development initiatives and plans from


concept to completion The Associate/Assistant Planner will work closely with property


owners, contractors, developers, administrators, permit technicians, and other City


Parish departments as you contribute to a wide variety of projects that affect our


community. We also foster a strengths based management style to assist in your growth


as a planning professional. The ideal candidate should have a great attitude, be detail


oriented, collaborative, capable of managing multiple projects and bringing


them to completion, and serve as a contributing member of the planning team.


Essential Functions and Duties


* Consult with citizens to provide information, guidance, and advice in response to inquiries regarding land use, zoning, platting, development applications, and other planning matters.


* Receives, reviews for completion, and processes development applications including evaluation of site plans, subdivision plats, rezoning applications, and other land development proposals; ensures applications conform to the development code and the Comprehensive Plan.


* Act as a liaison between community groups, government agencies, developers and elected officials in developing neighborhood plans.


* Utilizes the Geographic Information System (GIS) and ESRI data to assist in current planning and long\-range planning projects.


* Ability to review plans and apply provisions of the ordinances and codes to determine compliance with such regulations.


* Ability to multi\-task, prioritize, and receive direction leads, with the ability to also lead projects.


* Assist with grant writing, administration, and management.


* Knowledge of computer hardware and software programs, which may include Microsoft Office, Internet applications, database management, AutoCAD and/or GIS.


* Prepare for presentations with the use of graphics, charts, drawings, maps, as needed for special projects.


* Consults with citizens and developers and provides guidance on the development application process, including types of approvals that will be needed;


* Skilled in customer service, including the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both in person and in writing.


* Conducts field evaluations and assessments.


* Occasional evening or variable hours in order to attend meetings, are required.


* Perform other duties as deemed necessary and assigned.


Minimum Qualifications


Education: The position requires a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Urban Planning, Public Administration, Civil Engineering, Geography, Architecture or some other closely related field. Experience related to construction, architecture, and engineering related fields is a plus.


Required Experience: 0\-1 year of similar or related experience is preferred. (Internship experience is considered.) Four (4\) years related experience may substitute for a Bachelor's degree.


Have excellent oral, interpersonal and written skills.


Familiarity with using Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and/or Google Meet.


Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word, and Excel.


Licensure: The ability to convey oneself to and from geographical locations frequently and timely, and must possess and maintain a valid Louisiana Driver's License and acceptable driving record.


Additional Requirements:


* Applicants must pass employment background and drug screening test.


* Bilingual (English/Spanish) language skills preferred but not required.


Position available: This position will be open until filled.


Salary Range: $52,000 \- $60,000


Benefits:


Position offers medical, dental, vision, retirement, deferred compensation benefits, vacation/leave, paid and qualifying educational reimbursement.


How to join our team:


Please send a cover letter and resume by email to brownc@bossiercity.org


Websites: www.bossiercity.org


www.bossierparishla.gov


The Bossier City – Parish Metropolitan Planning Commission is an equal opportunity employer.
